title: Silkline
pitch: Spin walkable silk roads across the moonlit garden - but every bridge you build is also the hunters' highway straight back to you.
howto: Drag between glowing anchors to spin silk lines and reach nectar blooms. Hunters march your own roads: cut a line under a pursuer to drop it in the pond, arm sticky strands to snare wasps and mantises, then wrap the catch for silk and nectar. Eat leaves to refill silk; spend nectar at the Loom Shrine on capacity, reach, stickier dew and better reclaim.
controls: Drag anchor-to-anchor to spin, tap a line to cut. On-screen arrows + jump, spiral button to eat/wrap, web button arms sticky. Keyboard: WASD/Space, J act, K sticky. Gamepad: A jump, X act, B sticky.
